title: Natural / dry process
summary: Whole coffee cherries are dried before the dried fruit layers are removed.
limitations: A process name alone does not specify fermentation temperature, duration, inoculum or oxygen exposure.

title: Washed / wet process
summary: The described washed process removes cherry skin, breaks down mucilage, washes it away and dries coffee in parchment.
limitations: A process name alone does not specify fermentation temperature, duration, inoculum or oxygen exposure.

title: Honey / pulp natural
summary: Honey processing removes cherry skin while retaining mucilage during drying.
limitations: A process name alone does not specify fermentation temperature, duration, inoculum or oxygen exposure.
